changelog: - **Room for the arrowhead, and bend points by a port kept on the line.** When a line's last bend point was on the short stretch just before the node it points to, closer than the arrowhead's size, the line turned there and drew a very short end: the arrowhead covered the corner and could read as coming in from the side (the General gacha Template's line into Pulls made). The line now runs through that bend point straight into the node; the bend point stays where it is, and the line takes a small step before its end (two more corners), so it is not smoother. The last corner before an arrowhead is rounded a little less where full rounding left the arrowhead too little straight line. A line whose bend point next to a node is straight in line with its port now goes straight there instead of stepping aside and missing that point (the Pickup gacha Template's line into Pulls made); the other lines on that port can shift slightly, those without bend points included. A line end that is itself shorter than the arrowhead, as in a crowded bundle, is not lengthened.
